title: CSIR-IMMT Inaugurated Advanced E-Learning Centre under CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Science & Technology

CSIR-IMMT Inaugurated Advanced E-Learning Centre under CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative

प्रविष्टि तिथि:
29 JUL 2026 7:41PM by PIB Delhi

The CSIR–Institute of Minerals & Materials Technology (CSIR-IMMT), Bhubaneswar, inaugurated its
Advanced E-Learning Centre
 under the
CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative
 on 27
th
 July 2026 (Monday), marking a significant milestone in promoting digital learning, capacity building and skill development.

The programme commenced with a
tree plantation drive
 led by
Dr. Vinay Kumar, Scientist-G and Nodal Scientist, CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative, CSIR-Human Resource
Development Centre (CSIR-HRDC)
. The
Advanced E-Learning Centre
 was formally inaugurated by Dr. Vinay Kumar in the presence of
Dr. Ramanuj Narayan, Director, CSIR-IMMT
.

The inaugural ceremony was followed by a
Skill Development Meeting

at
S S Bhatnagar Hall
, attended by scientists, research scholars, students and staff of the institute.

Welcoming the gathering,
Dr. Ramanuj Narayan
, Director, CSIR-IMMT, highlighted the institute's commitment to strengthening digital education, innovation and skill development through modern learning infrastructure. He emphasized that the newly established centre would play an important role in expanding access to quality learning resources and enhancing the professional competencies of students, researchers and industry personnel.

Dr. Santosh Kumar Behera, Scientist-F and Skill Development Coordinator, CSIR-IMMT
, presented an overview of the institute's skill development initiatives under the CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative. He highlighted the successful implementation of various training programmes, industry-oriented courses and capacity-building activities that have benefited students, professionals and researchers from across the country.

Addressing the gathering,
Dr. Trupti Das, Scientist-G, Chief Scientist and Chairperson (HRD), CSIR-IMMT
, stressed the importance of continuous learning, human resource development and technology-enabled education in preparing a skilled workforce for emerging industrial and research challenges.

Dr. L. D. Besra, Scientist-G and Head, CSIR-IMMT,
 highlighted the importance of skill development programmes in enhancing employability, fostering innovation and bridging the gap between academic learning and industry requirements. He emphasized that continuous skill upgradation is essential for building a competent and future-ready workforce

Delivering the keynote address,
Dr. Vinay Kumar
 underscored the vision of the
CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative
 in creating a nationwide ecosystem for technology-enabled education, digital learning and industry-relevant skill development. He appreciated the efforts of CSIR-IMMT in establishing the Advanced E-Learning Centre and expressed confidence that it would serve as an important platform for online training, hybrid learning programmes, webinars, workshops and collaborative knowledge-sharing activities. The formal vote of thanks was delivered by
Dr. Manish Kumar
, Scientist-F.

The newly inaugurated
Advanced E-Learning Centre
 is equipped with modern digital infrastructure and is expected to significantly strengthen the institute's efforts in delivering high-quality online and hybrid training programmes under the
CSIR Integrated Skill Initiative
, thereby contributing to the development of a future-ready skilled workforce.
